title: Guru, The Perfect True Guru, Is My
summary: The shabad does not leave loneliness at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water
lifeApplication: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: I am a helpless child-please cherish me; the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: I am a helpless child-please cherish me; the Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining
evidence.turn: Neediness is not rejected here. It is brought honestly into the Guru's care.
